name: Ise no Taifu
bio: Poet of the Hyakunin Isshu (no. 61); Porter’s note gives the dates as: late 10th century.

poems.title: The double cherry trees, which grew
poems.author: Ise no Taifu
poems.collection: A Hundred Verses from Old Japan (Hyakunin Isshu), poem 61
poems.text:
The double cherry trees, which grew
At Nara in past days,
Now beautify this Palace, and
Their blossoms all ablaze
Perfume the royal ways.

poems.title: 61. 古への 奈良の都の 八重ざくら (Inishie no Nara no miyako no yaezakura)
poems.author: Ise no Taifu
poems.collection: 小倉百人一首 (Ogura Hyakunin Isshu)
poems.note: Classical Japanese; from the 詞花集
poems.text:
古への 奈良の都の 八重ざくら
今日九重に 匂ひぬるかな
